The Big Story · Technology & Security

One email platform. 51,628,280 records.

The breach did not begin at a railway or survey company. It reached them through an invisible service they shared—and the giant total still is not a count of unique people.

Japanese word of the day委託先 · いたくさき · itakusaki

A contractor or service provider entrusted with work. 委託 means “entrustment”; 先 identifies the receiving party. The term is common in official breach notices because the company a customer recognizes may not operate the affected system.

Example: 委託先で不正アクセスが確認されました—“Unauthorized access was confirmed at a service provider.” Practice free in the Japanese Training Lab, then learn while playing with DraMap for iOS.
